indexes.//: AppointmentService.fetchParticipants filters on both ends of a time slot. Two equality filters on different fields need a composite index.

fieldOverrides.//: AccountDeletionService sweeps every survey and appointment a user took part in with a collectionGroup query. Firestore auto-indexes single fields at COLLECTION scope only, so the COLLECTION_GROUP scope has to be opted into here — a single-field index cannot be declared in the composite 'indexes' array above.
